rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, but it executed a return (write action) without first confirming with the user, which violates the policy. It also failed to provide the requested refund amount or any itemized confirmation of which items were being returned (e.g., confirming exclusion of the tablet). The final message is a generic closing with no details. While the user appears to have been identified via name and zip, the critical requirements—confirm before making order changes and provide correct final information including the refund amount—were not met.
